service: Global OFAC, UN, EU Sanctions & PEP Watchlist AML Screener
description: Screens individuals, companies, and crypto/banking counterparties against consolidated OFAC SDN, UN Security Council, EU Financial Sanctions, and Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) watchlists. Computes fuzzy similarity and AML Risk Scores (0-100).

inputSchema.title: Global OFAC, UN, EU Sanctions & PEP Watchlist AML Screener Input
inputSchema.description: Configure target individual or organization name, optional entity type filter, and maximum watchlist screening records to return.

entityName.title: Entity or Individual Name to Screen
entityName.description: Organization, vessel, or individual name to screen for AML/KYC compliance (e.g., 'Lazarus Group', 'Garantex', 'Rosneft', 'Wagner').

maxResults.title: Maximum Screening Records
maxResults.description: Maximum number of sanctions & PEP watchlist hits to return and score (1 to 100).

entityQuery.title: Screened Query Name
entityQuery.description: Input name submitted for AML/KYC screening.

matchedName.title: Matched Watchlist Entity Name
matchedName.description: Official designated name on the sanctions or PEP list.

listSource.title: Sanctions Authority / List Source
listSource.description: US OFAC SDN, UN Security Council, EU FSF, UK OFSI, or Global PEP.

sanctionsProgram.title: Sanctions Program / Designation
sanctionsProgram.description: Specific regulatory program (e.g., CYBER2, DPRK3, RUSSIA-EO14024).

jurisdiction.title: Jurisdiction / Country ISO
jurisdiction.description: 2-letter ISO country code associated with the designated entity.

matchSimilarityScore.title: Fuzzy Name Similarity (0-100)
matchSimilarityScore.description: Token and Jaro-Winkler lexical similarity score (0-100).

markdownAmlBrief.title: Markdown AML & Sanctions Compliance Dossier
markdownAmlBrief.description: Executive Markdown AML/KYC audit trail for compliance officers and automated onboarding.

overview.title: Global OFAC, UN, EU Sanctions & PEP Watchlist Overview
